sources.observation: Two broad upper bays, cream sash first floor and four-light second floor; diamond brick band, red awnings and cream shop framing.
Chamfer entrance, red fascia/canopy, one narrow window per storey; decorated Stanley bay.
Plain brick rearward elevation, cream painted blocked ground apertures, pale pipework, asymmetric upper windows.
Tall narrow rearward windows, service doors, windows, vents, numerous soil pipes; source screenshot actually rendered.
Actual GPU photogrammetric roof examined at four 90-degree orbits and top down; hipped front roof, rear gable, lower parapeted service roofs, rear yards. Composite capture date unknown.
Combined amusement block seed; individual Embassy separated using roof and street evidence.
